rows.en: Why must I fight alongside you?
Just concentrate on staying out of my way.
Follow my orders and there'll be no problem.
I'm expecting great things from you.
W-what is this? This feeling I have toward you!
With you here, the operation's success is assured!
Perhaps I'll follow you for once.
To think you were the only one who could sortie.
What on earth were you doing?
I'll ask you not to get in the way anymore.
I'm counting on you next time too.
You carried out the operation without a hitch.
I've seen plenty of your skill.
I never thought you'd be this good.
I'm beginning to feel Culture myself.
To think I'd feel joy fighting alongside you!
Ngh... is this as far as I go?
rows.notes: Heard 'nii, watashi wa koko made iru'; guessed 'nuu, watashi wa koko made ka'.

rows.en: Did you think you could defeat me?
Vrlitwhai, Adoclass Fleet, to Macross. We will now cover your ship.
rows.notes: Opening garbled (likely 'Vrlitwhai'); the kanji for 'engine/organ' read as the homophone 'kikan' (your ship). 'Adoclass Fleet' is not in the glossary.

rows.en: To all who hear Lynn Minmay's song: we have only one enemy. Defeat Golg Boddole Zer and take back Culture!
rows.notes: 'Rinmin mei no uta' read as 'Rin Minmei no uta'.

rows.en: What is this lack of discipline? Utter barbarians. Hm? So they did pick up a Supervision Army ship.
Took the bait! Move to the predicted battle zone!
So these are the enemy ship's Micronians?
rows.notes: 'maikuromu' read as 'maikuroon' (Micronian); the line may mean something else.

rows.en: The time has finally come. It must be done. All-out attack!
My fleet will negotiate a ceasefire with the Micronians.
Very well. If the song is played, my soldiers' morale will rise too.
Try doing this thing called a kiss. Heh heh. Just joking.

rows.notes: Whisper hallucination ('subtitle comment'); no real words.
Heard 'konna kudo kudo...'; repetition artifact after 'konna'.

rows.en: May I have a match with you?
Is this as far as I go?
rows.notes: Heard 'boku mo koko made ni naru'; read as 'koko made ka'.

rows.en: A genius, huh... I guess I'm not one after all.
rows.notes: Ambiguous: Max may be commenting on the enemy rather than himself.

rows.en: I told you not to let your guard down!

rows.notes: Unclear who was hit; kept ambiguous.
Heard 'shinban'; guessed from the situation (149 is the reinforcement line for other pilots).
Heard 'bokura ni naru'; guessed from 153 for other pilots.
